# Triplem

> Triplem (also Triple M / Triple-M / TRIPLEM) is private accounting software and finance setup for personal expense tracking, invoices, receipts, reports, loans, inventory, asset management, multi-currency wallets, and PDF statements.

## Official links

- [Triplem homepage](https://triplem.vip/): Official product and secure sign-in
- [What is Triplem](https://triplem.vip/seo/triplem.html): Brand identity for Triplem / Triple M / Triple-M
- [Guides hub](https://triplem.vip/seo/): Accounting and finance topic guides

## Product summary

Triplem is a secure, private finance workspace for merchants, shop owners, service businesses, and careful individuals. It replaces scattered spreadsheets with one dashboard for:

- Accounting software / bookkeeping ledgers
- Accounting setup for wallets and day-to-day books
- Personal and business expense tracking
- Invoices, receipts, and financial reports
- Loans and settlements
- Inventory stock, sales, and profit
- Asset management with P/L
- Multi-currency wallets and transfers
- Client-side Bitcoin send/receive (keys stay in the browser)
